title: The 49th IPA Convention & Exhibition
excerpt: Get Ready for the 49th IPA Convex 2025! The most prestigious oil and gas event in Southeast Asia is back!
body:
Get Ready for the 49th IPA Convex 2025! The most prestigious oil and gas event in Southeast Asia is back!

Where industry leaders unite to share insights and drive innovation in the energy sector.

📅 Tuesday-Thursday, 20 - 22 May 2025

📍 ICE BSD City, Indonesia 

Register now through our official website at [convex.ipa.or.id](http://convex.ipa.or.id/) 

For Further Information, please contact us at [registrationipa@convex.ipa.or.id](mailto:registrationipa@convex.ipa.or.id) or WhatsApp at (+62) 812-8314-0443 (Ms. Wiwid) and don’t forget to follow [@ipaconvex_](https://instagram.com/ipaconvex_) for the latest updates!

Be part of the most anticipated energy event of the year and see you at The 49th IPA Convex 2025!
